answer: The correct-transcript route skips the recognizer’s possible mistakes. If that route falls from 4/4 to 2/4, a correct transcript is still not sufficient for the correction to answer well, so hearing cannot explain all of the decline. The actual-ASR route then checks the combined recognizer/answerer route using the same recognizer and actual transcripts for all three candidates; it also drops, from 3/4 to 2/4. Photo gains of 16/28 to 23/28 and 31/56 to 53/56 cannot make either chat route meet its separate at-least-base threshold. Accepting a correction also requires complete normal endings and a strictly better agreed composite score. Those are requirements together, so good photo scores alone do not justify delivery.
